bio_short_25: Satish Regonda is an Associate Professor of Civil Engineering and Climate Change at IIT Hyderabad, working on flood forecasting for Indian cities and rivers.
bio_short_60: Satish Regonda is an Associate Professor in the Departments of Civil Engineering and Climate Change at IIT Hyderabad. He spent seven years as a research hydrologist at NOAA's Office of Hydrologic Development, working on the US National Weather Service's Hydrologic Ensemble Forecast Service, before returning to India in 2017. He leads the RAFT research group, which builds flood forecasting and citizen-observation tools for Indian cities.
products_standfirst: Products and tools from the group that puts rainfall and flood information in the hands of the people who need it: a citizen reporting app, analytics for rainfall and river data, and apps for forecasters and researchers.
